subject: Renewal & capacity bump — procurement portal steps and onboarding kickoff
messages:
From: Rowan Miles <rowan@evermade.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, procurement@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & capacity bump — onboarding refresh & procurement portal steps

Hi Priya,

Hope you’re doing well — our renewal for the Redwood contract is coming up at the end of October and we want to both extend the term and increase committed capacity. A quick summary of what we’re asking for: 

- Term: 12 -> 24 months (start 11/01/2028)
- Capacity: committed token units increased by ~55% (roughly equivalent to moving from 2x to 3x host pool)
- Want to refresh vendor onboarding (SSO, SOC2 evidence) and confirm billing cadence (quarterly invoices/PO)

We’ve attached our procurement PO template and would like to understand:
1) Any changes to the pricing matrix for a 24-month commit + volume uplift
2) Whether a prorated invoice is possible for the added capacity effective 11/01/2028
3) Steps to complete the portal onboarding and any required attestation documents you need from us

Can we get a short mutual action plan and the portal link to submit the PO? If possible, we’d like a kickoff call next week to align timelines.

Thanks,
Rowan Miles
Director of Finance & Ops
Evermade

Attachments: Evermade_PO_template.pdf

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: Rowan Miles <rowan@evermade.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity bump — onboarding refresh & procurement portal steps

Rowan — thanks for the clear summary and the PO template. We’re happy to support the 24-month term + capacity uplift. High level next steps from our side: 

1) Pricing & commercial: Aditya will confirm updated pricing tiers for a 24-month commit and send a redline to your PO template.
2) Procurement portal: Hannah will send a one-time procurement portal invite and the DocuSign PO link; that portal will also capture SSO provisioning and billing contact.
3) Onboarding refresh / security: Please share current SOC2 or compliance artifacts; we’ll confirm any missing items. Laura can coordinate the evidence intake.
4) Kickoff: propose Tue 9/19 10:00am PT for a 30-minute kickoff — does that work?

We’ll aim to provide the mutual action plan (MAP) by end of day tomorrow.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Rowan Miles <rowan@evermade.com>, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity bump — pricing and PO items

Rowan — looping in commercial details. Preliminary notes: 

- 24-month commitment with ~55% capacity uplift qualifies for the "Committed Growth" pricing tier. I’ll send a pricing summary and the redlined PO shortly. Expect: list-price discount on per-token rate + one-time onboarding credit applied to first invoice.
- Prorating: we can prorate the uplift from 11/01/2028 for the remaining quarter; billing will show a separate line item for prorated tokens.
- Licensing: please confirm whether you want a burst pool or dedicated reserved pool for the uplift (burst for cost flexibility; dedicated for throughput guarantees).

Action items for Evermade: please return the completed PO template and indicate preferred pool type. We’ve attached a draft SOW for the onboarding refresh (minor updates to SSO and audit handoff).

Attachments: SOW_draft_v1.docx

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: Rowan Miles <rowan@evermade.com>, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity bump — procurement portal invite and DocuSign

Hi Rowan — I’ve created the procurement intake record in our portal and sent an invite to procurement@evermade.com. The portal will guide you through: PO upload, billing contact, SSO team contact, and evidence upload (SOC2, penetration test attestation).

Portal link: https://console.redwood.ai/procure/evermade/EVR-2028-09-RNW-77
DocuSign PO: https://docusign.com/REDW-EVR-PO-77

Notes / timings: 
- Please upload the completed PO template to the portal; once we receive the signed PO we’ll generate an invoice (first invoice will include any prorated uplift).
- If you choose a dedicated reserved pool, procurement will need to accept the dedicated capacity addendum — that is a small PO amendment (we’ll pre-fill the fields once you select dedicated vs burst).
- Kickoff: confirmed Tue 9/19 10:00am PT — calendar invite sent to your team.

If you need a custom billing schedule or regional invoicing (EU), let me know and I’ll add the finance reviewer.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Rowan Miles <rowan@evermade.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@evermade.com
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity bump — procurement portal steps and onboarding kickoff

Thanks team — quick update after the kickoff this morning: Evermade approves the 24-month term and will sign the PO today. Confirmed details: 

- Committed capacity: choose dedicated reserved pool (throughput guarantee needed for our inference SLA)
- Billing start date for uplift: 2028-11-01 (prorated charge will appear on the 11/30 invoice)
- We uploaded SOC2 Type II and recent penetration test summary to the portal (look for files under "evidence/uploaded").

I’ve signed the PO via DocuSign and uploaded the signed PDF to the portal. Please confirm when the dedicated pool is provisioned and when we can schedule the handoff to the onboarding engineer.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the refreshed onboarding.

Best,
Rowan Miles
Director of Finance & Ops
Evermade

Attachments in portal: Evermade_PO_signed.pdf
